humanFeedback.text: Now it's too straight. Find a non uniform bending
humanFeedback.label: Explicit correction request; not approval of a new candidate

hypothesis: Uneven, signed smooth bends with independent amplitudes and spacing can sit between repeated arcing limbs and rigid straight runs.
implementation: Each branch gets 2–4 unevenly spaced bend controls, changing bend direction and magnitude, smoothly interpolated using Hermite tangents. Separate curve random stream preserves the prior taper draws. Parent-relative branch and foliage attachment movement remains intact.

review.reviewer: Codex primary actual hero and detail image inspection
observations: Close-up shows softer nonuniform changes in limb direction rather than straight rods.
Curvature does not recreate the same bow shape across limbs.
The earlier fast taper, bark and continuous joints remain.
Foliage sprays and crown mass distribution remain stylized.

checks.targetedTest: passed; restrained but visible bend variation, quick taper, joint continuity, finite UVs and source preservation
checks.protected: No renderer or protected recipe edits in this pass.
